versions.changelog:
- Updated skill to generate Markdown-format weekly reports based on text task lists.
- Added support for splitting tasks by module with “重点工作” and “工作明细” sections.
- New input requirements: each task line must specify a module and content.
- Improved output structure, supporting any number of modules and tasks.
- Documentation and template details revised to guide usage and configuration.
- Removed README.md; all instructions are now in SKILL.md.
